beginner.summary: For developers, operations engineers and SREs who are starting with Datadog. Covers the platform and its products, a trial organisation with the Agent, infrastructure monitoring, integrations, metrics and custom metrics, dashboards and notebooks, monitors, log collection and pipelines, log indexes, archives and Flex Logs, APM with tracing libraries, the Software Catalog, RUM and Session Replay, synthetic tests, Kubernetes monitoring, SLOs, incidents and On-Call, the security products, access and usage management and troubleshooting missing data. Covers the Datadog Fundamentals certification topics.
prerequisites: Runs or supports web applications on Linux, containers or cloud services
Comfortable with the command line and YAML
Knows what metrics, logs and traces are
outcomes: Install and configure the Agent, integrations and unified service tagging
Build dashboards, monitors and SLOs from metrics, logs and traces
Collect, parse and control logs and instrument services with APM, RUM and synthetic tests
Run incidents and On-Call, manage access and usage and fix missing data

subtopics: Datadog as a SaaS observability and security platform

intermediate.summary: For engineers who run Datadog for several teams. Covers tag governance, Datadog as code with Terraform and the API, custom instrumentation and trace queries, the Continuous Profiler and Dynamic Instrumentation, Database Monitoring, Cloud Network Monitoring, Observability Pipelines, OpenTelemetry with the DDOT Collector, log cost control, Watchdog, monitor strategy at scale, Workflow Automation and App Builder, CI Visibility and Test Optimization, serverless monitoring, LLM Observability, Cloud Cost Management, Bits AI and the MCP server, security operations and certification preparation.
prerequisites: Has set up Agents, logs, APM, dashboards and monitors in Datadog
Comfortable with Terraform or another infrastructure as code tool
outcomes: Manage Datadog configuration and tagging as code for many teams
Instrument, profile and trace services and databases in depth
Control telemetry and cloud cost with pipelines, log tiers and cost data
Automate operations with Workflows and Bits AI, and prepare for the Datadog certifications

advanced.summary: For observability leads and architects who run Datadog across an organisation. prerequisites: Runs Datadog for several teams in production

outcomes: Design Datadog organisations, governance and telemetry strategy for a company
